calculation.description: Ranks assets for forward long exposure by the magnitude of a recent 10-day pullback normalized by 20-day downside RMS volatility, with a continuous multiplier that gives greater recovery preference to established positive 60-day trends while retaining a bounded signal in neutral or bearish regimes. Signal is shifted one completed trading day before validation/use.

validation.period: 2020-01-01 through 2029-11-14 data availability, forward observations through 2029-11-01
validation.regime_notes: Validated across 15 tradable cross-asset benchmark instruments and multiple regimes. Full-sample and recent-250 10-day ICIR clear the benchmark gates; uncertainty is interpreted conservatively because the cross-section is small.

signal_artifact.reconstruction: For each asset, compute daily returns; downside_rms_20d=sqrt(mean(min(return,0)^2 over 20 days)); return_10d=close/close.shift(10)-1; return_60d=close/close.shift(60)-1; raw=(-return_10d/(downside_rms_20d+1e-8))*(0.25+0.75*(1+tanh(return_60d/0.12))/2); use raw.shift(1).
